notes: All output differences/intervals in report.json are success-probability fractions.
CSV and Markdown contrasts use percentage points.
Fixed benchmark tasks are equally weighted.
One released checkpoint is separate from trained-seed replications.
No significance, equivalence, hardware-eligibility or accepted-study claim follows from these intervals.
notice: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY. Task-row validation and retained lifecycle closure do not establish hardware numerical eligibility. The mixed-device data include A100 PCIe results that failed the unchanged H100 numerical gate, and SXM results remain unqualified. Bootstrap intervals describe training-seed and initial-state variation within these observed executions; they do not account for unresolved numerical hardware differences or establish causal, hardware-invariant superiority. No accepted-full or archive completion marker is created. Secondary intervals are not multiplicity-adjusted.
